page.overview:
Who is Devon Blaine Marks?

is the main protagonist of The New Kid, the third story in Fazbear Frights 3: 1:35AM. He is a very troubled teenage boy who's desire to fit in with others at his school leads him down a dark and twisted path. Depending on how one interprets the story, Devon could be considered the main antagonist.

Devon is 5'9" with dark hair worn long and messy. He considers himself too skinny for his height. Devon’s teeth are super crooked, his ears are big and stick out of his hair, his neck is long, and his dark eyes are small and close together. He also has chewed-on cuticles and bitten-down nails. Due to his family's poor income, Devon only wears jeans and T-shirts.

Years of living outside social groups has taught Devon to hide his emotions and keep a neutral face. He is made bored by school and doesn’t care enough to “apply himself,” as his mother says. Devon also loves darkness, finding it to drown out the craziness that is real life. Unlike his best and only friend Mick, Devon has outgrown his childish behavior and has grown a hatred for things he thinks are childish. As a result, he is dismissive of Mick’s feelings most of the time and gets annoyed by him. After years of rejection, Devon grows a strong desire to try and fit in, leading to concerning and somewhat sociopathic behavior. He becomes obsessed with Heather, desperate to get her attention to a point where he stalks her in order to learn more about her. While Devon initially feels good around Kelsey, he quickly begins to resent how easily Kelsey fits in and makes friends. As Devon becomes increasingly delusional over Heather, his anger and jealousy towards Kelsey gets worse. Devon also isn’t honest and can be very aggressive, mercilessly killing a crow for pooping on his shoulder. Only Mick seems to temporarily negate his aggression thanks to their decade long friendship.

Devon was born to an abusive father who threw things at his mom. When Devon was three his dad left, leaving Devon and his mom alone. Devon's mom works as a house cleaner and doesn't make much money, leaving Devon with very few clothes and few options to eat for food. At school, he usually gets Bs and Cs with the occasional D because he doesn't care enough to truly focus on his work. He and his best and only friend Mick would hang out at an abandoned gas station. Devon enjoyed their hide-out as he could forget about school and the pressure being put on his mother to "be somebody" and not end up like her. Over their ten years of friendship Devon and Mick would constantly do things with each other, saying they were in it together. Eventually Devon gains a desire to be seen as cooler, and in an attempt to do so he slashes his jeans, tears his T-shirts, and slouches more. After a lecture from his mother he stops doing this.
